notes.title: Still here
notes.notes: [p]It has been quiet since we launched the Early Access page and that's because … well life happened.[/p][p][/p][p]I have been looking for a new place for quite some time and of course, right after we started working on the game properly I found something. And that meant I had to focus all my spare time on renovating and moving for many weeks and could not work on the game with the other two guys. [/p][p][/p][p]But this is done now and i am back on the game. [/p][p][/p][p]As a little teaser here is a gif of an effect I made. Currently I am working on some more ways the players action take a lasting effect on the field. The power shot is one of those:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502454/f8764f148af954dc1f1594649cbc11a5bde68066.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Andy is looking into connecting multiplayer over Steam to the game so fingers crossed, that would be quite something! Remote Play Together already works quite well but joining a friend over the Steam friends list would be so much better.[/p][p][/p][p]I will try to show progress more frequently if it is worth showing.[/p][p][/p][p]Till then, tata[/p][p]-- Fjo[/p]
